name: Dokuha
subtitle: SideStore & AltStore source for Dokuha (free Apple ID fork of Aidoku)
description:
SideStore and AltStore source for Dokuha, an open-source fork of Aidoku tailored for free Apple ID sideloading and cross-device sync.

Source code & releases: https://github.com/sfai05/Aidoku

apps.name: Dokuha
apps.subtitle: Open-source manga reader for iOS and iPadOS (Aidoku fork)
apps.localizedDescription: Dokuha is an open-source fork of Aidoku built for free Apple ID sideloading via SideStore/AltStore, with self-hostable PocketBase cross-device sync and manga management enhancements. Licensed under GPLv3.

privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Aidoku needs FaceID permissions for user-defined settings
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Aidoku needs permission to save pages in your photo library
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Aidoku needs permission to connect to local Komga and Kavita servers
